serp_intent_diagnosis.verdict: AMBIGUOUS-BUT-FISCAL. Google ID reads 'jaminan pemerintah' primarily in the LEGAL/FISCAL-DICTIONARY sense, not the jaminan sosial/BPJS sense. The feared social-security collision is weak on Google (BPJS appears only on Bing, at position 10). The real collision is different and worse: the SERP is fragmented across FOUR DIFFERENT government-guarantee regimes plus generic hukum jaminan (collateral law).
regimes_conflated_on_serp: Jaminan Pemerintah atas kewajiban pembayaran BUMN/BUMD (JDIH Kemenkeu kamus hukum)
Jaminan Pemerintah untuk Penyediaan Infrastruktur Prioritas / KPBU (JDIH Kemenkeu kamus hukum) — THE INFRASTRUCTURE SENSE, our target
Jaminan Pemerintah Pusat kepada Bank Pemberi Kredit (kredit program sense, JDIH Kemenkeu)
Perpres 103/2020 — Jaminan Pemerintah Pusat atas Pembiayaan Pembangunan / Pemulihan Ekonomi Nasional (risiko gagal bayar pinjaman & obligasi)
serp_intent_diagnosis.bing_contrast: Bing ID reads the query almost entirely as HUKUM JAMINAN (jaminan kebendaan / collateral): hukumonline, idntimes, kajianpustaka, Wikipedia 'Jaminan', gramedia — plus BPJS Kesehatan at #10. Only 2 of 10 Bing results are government-guarantee related. Adding 'KPBU' to the Bing query did NOT change the results, which shows how weakly the infrastructure sense is indexed for this term.
serp_intent_diagnosis.paa_confidence_signal: PAA for the exact keyword is generic and low-confidence ('Apa yang dimaksud dengan jaminan?', 'Penjamin artinya apa?'). Google is not confident what this query means. That is the whitespace.
serp_intent_diagnosis.disambiguation_requirement: BINDING for all 3 briefs. The first 60 words must name the infrastructure sense explicitly — 'jaminan pemerintah untuk proyek infrastruktur skema KPBU' — and must state in one clause what it is NOT (bukan jaminan sosial, bukan jaminan kredit/agunan, bukan jaminan pelaksanaan/bank garansi dalam pengadaan). Title, meta description, H1 and the first H2 must all carry an infrastructure/KPBU entity token so no engine files it as social-security or collateral-law content.

verified_facts_for_briefs.fact: Sampai dengan Juni 2026, PT PII telah memberikan penjaminan atas 61 proyek (38 KPBU & 23 Non-KPBU) di 7 sektor yaitu Jalan, Ketenagalistrikan, Telekomunikasi, Air Minum, Pariwisata, Transportasi, Persampahan dan Konservasi Energi dengan total nilai investasi lebih dari Rp 732 triliun.
verified_facts_for_briefs.researcher_note: Quote is verbatim from the client's own page. NOTE a defect the researcher must resolve: the page says '7 (tujuh) sektor' but then lists eight items. Do not reproduce the internal inconsistency — either cite the count without enumerating, or enumerate without asserting the count. The 38 KPBU vs 23 Non-KPBU split is the single most useful differentiating datapoint available for this cluster and should be used.

verified_facts_for_briefs.fact: Penjaminan Infrastruktur adalah pemberian jaminan atas kewajiban finansial PJPK untuk membayar kompensasi kepada Badan Usaha saat terjadi risiko infrastruktur sesuai dengan alokasi yang disepakati dalam perjanjian KPBU.
verified_facts_for_briefs.researcher_note: This is the canonical definition and should anchor the definition snippet in brief -01. It also settles the key nuance: the guarantee sits on the PJPK's FINANCIAL OBLIGATION, not on project success.

verified_facts_for_briefs.fact: PT PII bertindak sebagai penjamin tunggal (single window); bila kebutuhan penjaminan melampaui kapasitas permodalan PT PII, Kementerian Keuangan dapat memberikan co-guarantee.
verified_facts_for_briefs.researcher_note: Verify the co-guarantee mechanism against PMK 8/PMK.08/2016 before stating it as a live rule.

verified_facts_for_briefs.fact: PT PII menerbitkan Buku Acuan Alokasi Risiko (edisi tahun 2025 tersedia publik), dengan acuan per sektor: Jalan, Olah Raga, Kesehatan, Telekomunikasi, Kawasan, Air Minum.
verified_facts_for_briefs.researcher_note: First-party, dated, citable primary document — the strongest E-E-A-T asset available for briefs -01 and -03. Researcher should open the 2025 PDF to pull the actual risk-category names and stage grouping rather than paraphrasing from the portal.

verified_facts_for_briefs.fact: Perpres No. 78 Tahun 2010 tentang Penjaminan Infrastruktur dalam Proyek KPBU yang Dilakukan Melalui Badan Usaha Penjaminan Infrastruktur — ditetapkan 21 Desember 2010; status pada penelusuran 2026-08-12: Berlaku.
verified_facts_for_briefs.researcher_note: MUST be re-verified on peraturan.bpk.go.id or JDIH Kemenkeu at dossier time. Status read from search-result metadata, not from a direct page fetch.

verified_facts_for_briefs.fact: Perpres No. 103 Tahun 2020 tentang Jaminan Pemerintah Pusat atas Pembiayaan Pembangunan dalam Rangka Mendorong Perekonomian Nasional dan/atau Program Pemulihan Ekonomi Nasional — ditetapkan 26 Oktober 2020. Menjamin risiko gagal bayar pinjaman dan/atau surat utang/obligasi.
verified_facts_for_briefs.researcher_note: This is a SEPARATE regime from Perpres 78/2010 and is the backbone of brief -02. Verify current status (it may be time-bound to the PEN programme) before the article treats it as live law. If it is no longer operative, the brief's comparison still works but must be framed historically.

verified_facts_for_briefs.fact: Dasar hukum pelaksanaan penjaminan infrastruktur KPBU: PMK No. 260/PMK.011/2010 sebagaimana diubah dengan PMK No. 8/PMK.08/2016.
verified_facts_for_briefs.researcher_note: Confirm both PMKs are still in force via JDIH Kemenkeu. Cite by number and year only after confirmation.

verified_facts_for_briefs.fact: Setelah membayar klaim kepada Badan Usaha Pelaksana, PT PII mengaktifkan hak regres terhadap PJPK; dana yang telah dibayarkan pada akhirnya harus dikembalikan oleh PJPK.
